_about: Current-fact check of every time-sensitive BenHalluEval QA seed, done by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) with web search on 2026-10-13. Keys are unique-question indexes (same as audit_claude.txt). check: updated = gold replaced by the 2026 fact and the passage sentence that stated the old fact patched to support it (question never changed); still_correct = the gold is still true; kept_unverified = no reliable current figure or the sources disagree, so the gold is kept; kept_vacant = the post is empty now, so no current answer exists. patches: [old exact substring, new substring]; each old substring must occur exactly once in the passage.
